title: 5 free tools that replace $1,140/mo of business software
subtitle: All open source. Self-host for free or use the free tier. Set up in an afternoon.
cta: Follow Zero Cost AI for one free tool a day.

items.name: n8n
items.what: Visual workflow automation with 400+ integrations and native AI agent nodes. Connect your CRM, inbox, Sheets and LLMs without code.

items.name: Twenty
items.what: A modern open-source CRM. Pipelines, contacts, notes, tasks, email sync. Looks like Notion, works like Salesforce.

items.name: Chatwoot
items.what: Omnichannel customer support inbox: website chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, email. Add an AI agent that answers from your docs.

items.name: Cal.com
items.what: Scheduling infrastructure. Booking pages, round-robin, payments, reminders. Self-host and brand it as your own.

items.name: Open WebUI + Ollama
items.what: A private ChatGPT for your whole team running on your own machine. Upload documents, chat with them, no per-seat fees.
items.how: ollama run llama3 && docker run ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui

_note: Star counts refreshed 2026-11-02 from GitHub API. Prices are illustrative list prices; verify on vendor pricing pages before posting.
